item.title: ‘Women with young children are frequently expected to prove they are prioritizing work’
item.description: This week Women in Solar+ Europe gives voice to Alba Sande, lawyer at Spanish law firm ASande Legal. She states that, despite progress, women remain underrepresented in the renewable energy industry. "As a woman and a mother, I have often encountered the unspoken assumption that professional ambition must take a backseat to family life, a bias rarely applied to men," she says.

item.title: Cubenergy releases energy storage block for utility, C&I applications
item.description: Cubenergy has launched FlexCombo 2.0, a scalable battery energy storage system for utility, commercial, and industrial applications, offering up to 16 MWh capacity with LFP batteries. Its modular design, advanced BMS, and cloud-based operations enable easy installation, seamless expansion, and efficient grid integration, according to the manufacturer.

item.title: Chinese PV Industry Brief: Polysilicon output set to fall by 15% in January
item.description: Polysilicon trading in China remained largely inactive, with production cuts accelerating and wafer prices falling week on week, while downstream cell prices continued to rise and module prices held steady, according to a trade group representing China's nonferrous metals sector.

item.title: Agrivoltaics can help lettuce survive extreme heat
item.description: Scientists have grown organic romaine lettuce under 13 different types of PV modules, in an unusual hot Canadian summer. Their analysis showed lettuce yields increased by over 400% compared to unshaded control plants.

item.title: TheStorage launches its first industrial-scale sand-based heat storage system
item.description: The Finnish start-up says its sand battery technology is scalable from 20 to 500 MWh with charging power from 1 to 20 MW, depending on industrial needs.

item.title: DKEM seeks $57.5 million in twin patent suits against Chinese PV rivals
item.description: Wuxi DK Electronic Materials is pursuing two patent infringement cases against domestic competitors, seeking injunctions, equipment destruction, and combined damages of CNY 400 million ($57.5 million).

item.title: Octopus Energy to set up joint venture to trade renewables in China
item.description: UK-based Octopus Energy has agreed to set up a joint venture in China focused on spot power trading, in a bid to scale renewable electricity volumes as market reforms and demand growth accelerate.

item.title: The Hydrogen Stream: Repsol, Sunfire advance 200 MW of green H2 in Spain
item.description: Repsol and Sunfire are advancing 200 MW of renewable hydrogen projects in Spain, while new collaborations and funding across Europe and India aim to accelerate electrolyzer development and hydrogen infrastructure.

item.title: Uncertainty looms as U.S. solar PPA prices climb for second straight quarter
item.description: A report from LevelTen Energy finds solar PPA prices in North America rose 3.2% in Q4 2025, marking a nearly 9% year-over-year increase as developers and buyers navigate a complex “post-OBBBA” regulatory environment.

item.title: China added 66.43 GW of new-type energy storage in 2025
item.description: CNESA says China’s non-pumped storage technologies hit 144.7 GW in 2025, with 66.43 GW added.
